items.title: 5.2.1 Measures of Central Tendency (Mean, Median, Mode) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.2.1 (PDF 128, printed 125).

blocks.text: Measures of central tendency data ka “center” (beech) ya typical value (aam qeemat) dhoondne mein madad dete hain. Teen bare measures hain: mean, median aur mode. Yeh batate hain ke data mein average (ausat) ya sab se zyada aane wali qeemat kya hai.
Mean tamam numbers ka average (ausat) hai. Mean nikalne ke liye sab numbers jama karein aur jitne numbers hain un ki ginti se divide karein.

Misal: 5 students ne test mein 50, 60, 70, 80 aur 90 number liye. Mean nikalne ke liye sab scores jama kar ke students ki ginti se divide karte hain: (50 + 60 + 70 + 80 + 90) ÷ 5 = 350 ÷ 5 = 70. Is se group ki aam performance (karkardagi, kitna achha kiya) ka andaza hota hai.

Jab numbers ko order (chhote se bare ki line) mein rakhein to beech wali qeemat median hai. Agar qeematein odd (taaq: 1, 3, 5...) hon to median bilkul beech wala number hai. Agar qeematein even (juft: 2, 4, 6...) hon to median beech ke do numbers ka average hai.

Misal: Wahi scores 50, 60, 70, 80 aur 90. Ascending order (chhote se bare) mein yeh pehle se hain, beech wali qeemat 70 hai, is liye median 70 hai. Even ginti ki misal: agar scores 50, 60, 70 aur 80 hon to beech ke do scores (60 aur 70) ka average lenge:
Median data ka middle point (beech wali jagah) samajhne mein madad deta hai.
Mode woh number hai jo data mein sab se zyada baar aata hai. Agar kai numbers barabar sab se zyada baar aayein to ek se zyada mode ho sakte hain.
Misal: 5 students ke scores 50, 60, 70, 70 aur 90 hain. 70 do baar aata hai aur baqi sab ek ek baar, is liye mode 70 hai.
Kai modes ki misal: scores 50, 60, 70, 70, 60 aur 90 hon to 60 aur 70 dono do do baar aate hain. Is liye do modes hain: 60 aur 70.
Mode data mein sab se zyada aane wali (sab se aam) qeemat pehchanne mein madad deta hai.
Yeh program scores ka mean, median aur mode nikalta hai. scores ki list badal kar Run karein (maslan ek number aur jor dein ya 70 ki jagah 60 likhein) aur dekhein teeno qeematein kaise badalti hain.

scores = [50, 60, 70, 70, 90]  # test scores

import statistics

mean = sum(scores) / len(scores)
median = statistics.median(scores)
modes = statistics.multimode(scores)  # all values that come most often

print("Scores:", scores)
print("Mean   =", sum(scores), "/", len(scores), "=", round(mean, 2))
print("Median =", median)
print("Mode(s) =", modes)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"scores = [50, 60, 70, 70, 90]": paanch test scores ki list.
"import statistics": Python ki statistics library (tayyar functions ka majmua) laata hai jis mein median aur mode ke functions hain.
"mean = sum(scores) / len(scores)": mean (ausat) = sab ka jama / ginti = 340 / 5 = 68.0.
"statistics.median(scores)": sorted list ki beech wali qeemat deta hai; yahan teesri qeemat 70.
"statistics.multimode(scores)": woh saari qeematein list mein deta hai jo sab se zyada baar aati hain; 70 do baar hai, is liye [70].
Aakhri chaar print lines: scores, mean ka hisab (jama / ginti = jawab), median aur mode dikhati hain. round(mean, 2) jawab ko 2 decimal tak gol karta hai.
Output: "Scores: [50, 60, 70, 70, 90]", "Mean   = 340 / 5 = 68.0", "Median = 70" aur "Mode(s) = [70]".
Khud try karein: pehle 70 ko 60 kar dein (scores = [50, 60, 60, 70, 90]): ab mean 66.0, median 60 aur mode [60] aayega.

blocks.prompt: 4, 7, 7, 9, 13 ka mean, median aur mode nikalein.
blocks.explanation: Mean = (4 + 7 + 7 + 9 + 13) ÷ 5 = 40 ÷ 5 = 8; median = 7 (beech wali qeemat); mode = 7 (do baar aata hai).

items: Mean: average; median: order mein beech ki qeemat; mode: sab se zyada aane wali qeemat.
